notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 passive regional subscription surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and any logical-time implementation. It verifies passive regional subscription suppression of discovery and reflection, ObjectInstanceNotKnown lookup behavior, active subscription replacement and subsequent discovery/reflection, conveyed source-region metadata, and independent subscription and region cleanup without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional publication, registration, subscription, update, switch, lookup, unsubscription, and cleanup services with FederateAmbassador discovery and reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador passive regional subscription declarations
